evals.prompt: I need to track the work for adding rate limiting to the ByteDesk Gateway service. Create a Jira task for this in the BDP project and get it set up so I can start coding.
evals.expected_output: Searches Jira for existing rate limiting issues first, then creates a Task in BDP project with appropriate summary, description, and labels (service:gateway). Transitions the issue to In Progress. Returns the BDP-N URL.
expectations: Searched Jira for existing rate limiting issues before creating a new one
Created issue as Task type (not Feature, Bug, or Story)
Transitioned the issue to In Progress status

evals.prompt: We just merged PR #185 which finished the work on BDP-155. Mark that ticket done and check if its parent epic should also be closed.
evals.expected_output: Retrieves BDP-155 from Jira, transitions it to Done, then checks the parent epic's child issues to see if all are complete. If so, transitions the epic to Done as well.
expectations: Retrieved BDP-155 from Jira to read current state before transitioning
Checked the parent Epic for BDP-155
Assessed whether all child tasks of the epic are in Done status
Took appropriate action on the epic (close if all done, leave open otherwise)

evals.prompt: The prospecting pipeline is taking too long to return results — users wait 8+ seconds for the radar scan. I want to track this as a p0 priority tech debt issue.
evals.expected_output: Searches for existing perf-related tickets in BDP project, creates a Task with priority:p0 and tech-debt labels, provides clear description of the symptom and impact.
expectations: Searched Jira for existing performance/radar scan issues before creating
Created issue as Task type with summary describing the 8-second latency issue
Applied appropriate service label (service:sales or similar)
